lines.zh: 鳍在地上撑着走，一下一下。
lines.en: My fins push me along the ground, step by step.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，肚子贴着土。
lines.en: Slow. My belly brushes the soil.

lines.zh: 鳍的边缘刮着枯草，沙沙响。
lines.en: Fin edges rasp the dead grass.
I follow the cracks in the dead ground.

lines.zh: 一队四个，我排在第二个。
lines.en: Four of us. I'm second in line.

lines.zh: 这地方干得裂开，我还是往前走。
lines.en: The ground is cracked dry. I walk on.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一张一合，像在抓地。
lines.en: My fins open and close, catching the ground.
Two steps, a pause for breath.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边找能入口的。
lines.en: Walking and looking for anything edible.

lines.zh: 地上没什么活的，我照样走。
lines.en: Nothing alive here. I walk anyway.

lines.zh: 我绕开水洼，那水是苦的。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle. That water is bitter.
Dry scales cling to my fin tips.

lines.zh: 枯竭原野的鳞片，跟着影子。
lines.en: Withered plains scales. Follow the shadow.

lines.zh: 枯竭的地面，走路没有回声。
lines.en: Dead ground. My steps make no echo.

lines.zh: 我往前挪，背上的鳞蹭掉了。
lines.en: I shuffle on. Scales scrape off my back.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，土更干了。
lines.en: The soil dries further where I pass.
I stop. Fins braced on the ground.
I spread my fins to dry.
The wind here carries no moisture.

lines.zh: 我身边的人也停下来了。
lines.en: The others stopped too.

lines.zh: 我低头找吃的，什么也没有。
lines.en: I look down for food. Nothing.

lines.zh: 我的鳞现在是灰的，本来不是。
lines.en: My scales are grey now. They weren't.
I keep still. Save strength.

lines.zh: 远处有一株枯草，我盯着它。
lines.en: A dead stalk far off. I stare at it.
I lick a fin tip. Salty.

lines.zh: 肚子在响，可这片地没东西。
lines.en: My stomach growls. Nothing here.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，藏在枯草里。
lines.en: I flatten myself into the dead grass.

lines.zh: 同一片地上，我们几个轮流看。
lines.en: We take turns watching this patch.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻空气里有没有水。
lines.en: I lift my head. Any water in the air?

lines.zh: 什么都不动，连虫子也躲了。
lines.en: Nothing moves. Even the bugs hide.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨了一下眼，很干。
lines.en: I blink once. Dry eyes.
I'll wait for the wind to pass.

lines.zh: 你比我们高很多，怕不怕。
lines.en: You're much taller. Are you afraid?

lines.zh: 我的鳍抬起来了，看清了。
lines.en: My fins are up. Look closely.

lines.zh: 你身上有水，我闻出来了。
lines.en: You carry water. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，鳍往你那边张。
lines.en: Head tilted, fins opening toward you.

lines.zh: 你的脚一退，我的鳍就跟上。
lines.en: When your foot retreats, my fins follow.

lines.zh: 你脚边的土是湿的，因为你。
lines.en: The soil by your feet is damp. You did that.
I'm just looking. Nothing more.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我和同伴隔开了。
lines.en: Your shadow cut me off from the others.

lines.zh: 我这样看，是因为你很奇怪。
lines.en: I stare because you're strange.
If you don't move, I will.
All of us are watching you.
Don't step on my fins.
I'm flipped. Hard to right myself.
A few scales came off me.
I shuffle aside. Away.

lines.zh: 这一下，我认得你的鞋了。
lines.en: Now I know your boots.
I won't cry out. That draws attention.
The pain pulled my fins in.
A withered scale came off.
I pushed off the ground. Held.
Hitting me made me thirstier.

lines.zh: 这点伤，在这片地上不算什么。
lines.en: On this ground, this is nothing.
Water. You have water.
That green thing. Edible?

lines.zh: 有水味，我的鳍先伸了过去。
lines.en: Smells of water—my fins reach out first.
Crouch down so I can reach.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在地上一撑一撑。
lines.en: My fins push at the ground.
Don't hold it high. I can't climb.
The damp in your palm. I want it.
All of us are hungry.

lines.zh: 放下，退开，我会自己过去。
lines.en: Set it down, step back. I'll come.

lines.zh: 这东西在枯地上太显眼。
lines.en: That stands out on dead ground.
A bit closer. Don't move.
One bite. Let me taste.

lines.zh: 你要是不给，我就跟着你。
lines.en: If you won't give it, I'll follow.

lines.zh: 我的鳍能抓住东西，很紧。
lines.en: My fins can grip. Tightly.
That smell reminds me of water.

lines.zh: 我会一直看着你，直到你放下。
lines.en: I'll watch until you put it down.
Don't step there—my fins still need to row through sand.
Half a step back, fins braced.
My scales scraped your boot.

lines.zh: 别挤，我们本来就挨得近。
lines.en: Don't crowd. We're close already.
You bumped me and I rolled over.
I got up. Clumsily.
You loosened the soil.

lines.zh: 这么小的一只，撞不过你。
lines.en: Something this small can't push you.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚边挪过去。
lines.en: I edge past your feet.
I go around the print you made.
Among us, I'll pick one.

lines.zh: 先在枯地上并排走一段。
lines.en: Let's walk side by side on the dead ground.
Fin against fin. That's a yes.
This land can't feed more of us.
I shake my scales for you to see.
Not enough water. Only one clutch.
Come near, but don't spread your fins.
Wait until it rains.

lines.zh: 我的鳞色淡了，配不上你。
lines.en: My scales faded. Not good enough for you.
We have to follow the water.
I pinch it with my fins. Hard work.
Damp here. Right here.
Edible? Not sure.

lines.zh: 我用鳍夹着啃，硬得硌牙。
lines.en: I gnaw it between my fins; it's hard enough to chip teeth.
I tuck it between my fins.
A hint of water in this.
The others came over too.

lines.zh: 我捡起枯鳞，没用也收着。
lines.en: I pick up a dead scale. Useless, but I keep it.
Yours? I thought it was food.
Too slick. It slipped back.
You have water. That's enough.
My fin tips turned toward you.
All of us stopped.

lines.zh: 你踩的这块地是我们的。
lines.en: This patch you're on is ours.
I see the flask at your belt.
You moved. I'll trail you.
Nothing else alive here.

lines.zh: 我鳍短，追起来却一步不落。
lines.en: My fins are short, but I never fall a step behind.

lines.zh: 你脚下的土在响，我听得见。
lines.en: The soil crunches under you. I hear it.

lines.zh: 你在找路，我们不给你留。
lines.en: You're looking for a way out. We leave none.
I close in, fin by fin.
You retreat. We spread out.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在地上抓得很紧。
lines.en: My fins grip the ground hard.
Don't spill that water on you.
We know every inch of this dead ground.
You can't get around all of us.
Waiting for the one ahead to move first.
My gills work. No water for them.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在干土上，很长。
lines.en: Your shadow lies long on the dry soil.
One step closer and my fin reaches you.
My fins clamp your ankle.

lines.zh: 我的鳍夹住你，牙跟着咬下去。
lines.en: My fins clamp on, then my teeth bite down.

lines.zh: 我鳍一收，你的脚踝就见血。
lines.en: One squeeze of my fins and your ankle bleeds.

lines.zh: 你把我甩开了，我滚了两圈。
lines.en: You threw me off. I rolled twice.
I bite your trouser leg and hold.

lines.zh: 同伴从另一边也上来了。
lines.en: The others came from the other side.
My fin edge is hard. Like a blade.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，踩到我的同伴。
lines.en: You stepped back onto one of mine.
That one flipped me over too.
A few shallow cuts on you.

lines.zh: 我和三个同伴从枯草里爬出来。
lines.en: Three companions and I crawl out of the dead grass.

lines.zh: 四个一起，从枯草里现身。
lines.en: Four of us, out of the dead grass.
This ground is dry as a pot bottom.

lines.zh: 饥饿原野上，水比肉还难找。
lines.en: On the starving plain, water is scarcer than meat.

lines.zh: 鳍一落地，尘土就起来了。
lines.en: Fins touch down. Dust rises.

lines.zh: 我们挨在一起，挤着站稳。
lines.en: We stand packed together.
Withered grass hides me nicely.
I sniff upward. No rain.

lines.zh: 这片原野多了一队我们。
lines.en: The field gained a squad of us.

lines.zh: 我从土里翻了个身，站起来。
lines.en: I rolled over in the dirt and stood.
Fire curled my fins.

lines.zh: 摔到地上，鳞缝里全是土。
lines.en: Hit the ground. Dirt in every scale gap.
Water doesn't scare me. This is too deep.
The blast scattered all of us.
Something stuck between my fins.

lines.zh: 这力量让我鳞片全竖了。
lines.en: That power stood every scale on end.
Hungrier. Fins can't hold.

lines.zh: 雷打在枯地上，我们全亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning on dead ground. We all lit up.
Falling. Still paddling.
